description: Only with the agent token start_planner or start_subscription returned, and only until the person first opens a connection link: when they lost it (or it expired), returns a new single-use claimUrl for this token's own owner, valid for 24 hours, and the earlier unused link stops working. Give claimUrl only to that person; opening it saves their planner key in their browser. At most 3 a day. Once any link has been opened it answers 409 already_claimed: the person already has their key, in their saved planner link or through Restore on the planner page. Creates no account and charges nothing.
name: reissue_claim
title: Reissue the connection link
